Postdoc in Nutritional Metabolomics, Department of Nutrition, Exercise and Sports
 Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen

  Are you interested in metabolomics and its role in advancing nutrition research? Are you good at working independently, but also enjoy being part of an ambitious and collaborating team? Are you driven by challenging the status quo? Then you might be our new postdoc! The position is to be filled by 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  This 2-year postdoctoral position addresses latest innovations in biomarker-driven dietary assessment to improve nutrition research with a specific interest in cardiometabolic diseases. The primary tasks are to validate biomarkers for the intake of commonly consumed foods and to utilize them in estimating dietary intake in nutrition studies. For this, the postdoc will work with LC-MS metabolomics profiles of human samples and will develop data-driven frameworks for the implementation of biomarkers of food intake as dietary assessment tools. The position is affiliated with the Foodprints project funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation.

  Responsibilities and qualifications

  We are looking for a motivated postdoctoral researcher interested in elucidating how an objective dietary assessment contributes to a better understanding of diet-cardiometabolic risk interactions by performing metabolomics analyses and integrating omics with self-reported dietary data from human studies. Additionally, the candidate will be involved in the supervision of the group’s Ph.D., Master and Bachelor students. The work will involve:

   	
• LC-MS data extraction and preprocessing 	
• Integration of diet and metabolomics data through uni- and multivariate statistical analyses 	
• Collaboration with other researchers, technicians and students affiliated with the project 	
• Dissemination of results in the form of conference contributions and scientific publications 	
• Teaching at nutrition and metabolomics courses depending on interests/expertise   The candidate we seek

   	
• Has a PhD degree in metabolomics, chemometrics, bioinformatics or other related areas, ideally applied to human research 	
• Has demonstrated expertise in mass-spectrometric data analyses (e.g. metabolomics) 	
• Has demonstrated expertise in omics data integration and flair for programming (R is an advantage) 	
• Has an excellent publication track record (or equivalent experience) and strong scientific drive 	
• Is motivated by both personal and team accomplishments 	
• Thrives on multidisciplinary collaboration and is curious and open-minded 	
• Has experience and a proven track record of successful collaboration in diverse research environments   As a formal requirement, you must hold a PhD degree (or equivalent). Experience with nutrition research (dietary interventions and/or cohort studies) is an advantage.

  We offer

  The period of employment is 2 years. The expected starting date is 1st of April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  You will contribute to the activities of the Nutrition and Biomarkers Group led by Assistant Professor Catalina Cuparencu, which is embeded within the Nutrition, Microbiome and Metabolomics Research Group at Department of Nutrition, Exercise and Sports, Faculty of Science at University of Copenhagen. We offer a dynamic, sociable, collaborative, and international environment with exciting scientific challenges and opportunities to further develop your scientific career. Beyond our expertise in nutrition, microbiome and metabolomics, we offer access to our metabolomics facility and facilities dedicated to cohort- and intervention studies.

  The University is situated in Copenhagen, which is consistently rated among the world's top 10 most livable and sustainable cities. Life for families is made easier via a publicly supported daycare and healthcare system, dual-career opportunities, maternity/parental leave, and six weeks of annual vacation. International candidates may find useful information on living and working in Denmark. Useful information is also available at the university’s International Staff Mobility (ISM) office, which offers a variety of services to international researchers coming to and working at the University of Copenhagen.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Terms of employment

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

You will have the opportunity to work across the software stack, from embedded systems and flight control integration to simulation, telemetry, and ground-based applications. You'll join a small, ambitious team where your contributions will have a direct impact on the aircraft we build.

As part of our growing engineering team, you will develop and integrate software for our high-speed, heavy-lift cargo UAVs and their supporting systems.

You will work closely with electronics, mechanical, and aerospace engineers to turn ideas into working solutions, taking software from development through simulation, hardware integration, and real-world flight testing.

We believe that reliable software starts with good engineering practices. Code reviews, automated testing, continuous integration, and reproducible builds are important parts of how we want to develop our systems.

You will:

• 
Work with embedded Linux platforms, flight computers, sensors, actuators, and communication systems.

Experience with simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or real-time systems.

PhD Project in Muscular signaling and metabolism

  Nutrition Exercise and Sports (NEXS), Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen

  The August Krogh Section for Human and Molecular Physiology at Department of Nutrition, Exercise and Sports invites applicants for a PhD fellowship in “Elucidating the role of AMPK in Skeletal Muscular signaling and metabolism”. The project is part of the research project “Illuminating the signaling architecture of skeletal muscle insulin resistance”, which is financed by the Novo Nordisk Foundation

  Start date is (expected to be) 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The project

  By the use of phophosproteomics in human skeletal muscle, we recently discovered a novel phosphorylation site on AMPK alpha2 subunit regulated by mTORC1. This phosphorylation is associate with glucose uptake. We now wish to explore the relationship between the catabolic signal from AMPK and the anabolic signal from mTORC1 and the potential causal link to metabolic regulation. The project will primarily be conducted in mice by the use of transgenic KI models.

  Who are we looking for?

  We welcome applications from candidates with a strong academic background in physiology, biology, biomedical sciences, exercise science or a related field, and an interest in skeletal muscle physiology and metabolic regulation.

  The project combines animal studies with molecular and metabolic analyses. Experience in one or more relevant areas is an advantage, but applicants are not expected to have all of the skills already. Relevant experience could include in vivo or ex vivo research, metabolic phenotyping, muscle physiology, tissue processing, immunoblotting, immunoprecipitation or tracer-based assays.

  An interest in molecular signalling pathways involved in metabolism, including AMPK and nutrient sensing, would be valuable. Above all, we are looking for a curious and motivated researcher who is keen to learn and develop within a collaborative research environment.

  Our group and research- and what do we offer?

  The group is a part of Department of Nutrition, Exercise and Sports at the Faculty of Scince, University of Copenhagen. We are located in Copenhagen.

  We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and animal facilities.

  Our group work focuses on the molecular mechanisms through which physical activity promotes metabolic health.

  We are particularly interested in the intracellular interactions between exercise-induced signaling events and those triggered by insulin, aiming to unravel how a single bout of exercise can enhance muscle insulin sensitivity. Central to these studies is the role of AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) and its interacting partners, including mTOR and TBC1D4.

  We are studying this in humans using various cell/animal models for validation and mechanistic analyses.

  Principal supervisor is Professor Jørgen Wojtaszewski (NEXS, JW@nexs.ku.dk, 45 28751625) and Associate professor Rasmus Kjøbsted (NEXS, Rasmus.Kjobsted@nexs.ku.dk, 45 28344370)

   

  The PhD programme
 
 Qualifications needed for the regular programme
 
 To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have cand. med. (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 180 ECTS/3 FTE MSc). For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

  Terms of employment in the regular programme 
 
 Employment as PhD fellow is full time and for maximum 3 years.

  Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.

  The terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State (AC). The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

  Responsibilities and tasks in the PhD programmes

   	
• Complete and pass the MSc education in accordance with the curriculum of the MSc programme (ONLY when you are attending the integrated MSc and PhD programme)    	
• Carry through an independent research project under supervision    	
• Complete PhD courses corresponding to approx. 30 ECTS / ½ FTE 	
• Participate in active research environments, including a stay at another research institution, preferably abroad 	
• Teaching and knowledge dissemination activities 	
• Write scientific papers aimed at high-impact journals 	
• Write and defend a PhD thesis on the basis of your project   We are looking for the following qualifications:

   	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Diploma allowing independent work with experimental animals 	
• Experiences with experimental animal work 	
• Experiences with experimental animal work related to metabolism and cellular signaling 	
• Experiences with experimental animal work related to skeletal muscle 	
• Curious mind-set with a strong interest in muscle metabolism and cellular signaling 	
• Good English language skills   ***************************************************************************

  Application and Assessment Procedure

   Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include: 

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page) 	
• Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position 	
• Original diplomas for Bachelor or Master and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. 	
• Publication list (if possible) 	
• Reference letters (if available)   Application deadline: 

  The deadline for applications is 6 December 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. 

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment by an unbiased expert assessor. You are notified whether you will be passed for assessment.

  The assessor will assess the qualifications and experience of the shortlisted applicants with respect to the above-mentioned research area, techniques, skills and other requirements. The assessor will conclude whether each applicant is qualified and, if so, for which of the two models. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessment. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews with selected candidates are expected to be held in January 2027

  Questions

Postdoc at the Department of Biomedical Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, NNF Center of Stem Cell Medicine (reNEW), University of Copenhagen

  The Friesen group is looking for a motivated researcher with experience in stem cell biology and metabolism for a postdoctoral position, to commence on January 15, 2027 (or after agreement).

  About us

  The newly established Friesen lab aims to understand, treat and prevent metabolic disease. We want to explore how a cell transitions from a healthy state to insulin resistance to type 2 diabetes and to reverse this process. Our group leverages human pluripotent stem cell (hPSC)-derived in vitro disease models that accurately represent the in vivo cell state. We study the molecular underpinnings of metabolism and insulin signaling in a variety of cell types, improving in vitro hPSC-derived metabolic disease models, and applying these for translational research.

  Your role

  Your tasks will include designing experimental strategies, executing wet lab biology experiments, data analysis, and scientific writing and presentation. Additional tasks could include contributing to grant applications, and research-based supervision of MSc or PhD students.

  As a postdoctoral researcher in our lab, you will play a key role in leading a research project to completion. As a founding team member in a new lab, you will have a hand in shaping the lab’s culture and research direction, and you will have early ownership of projects. You will contribute to metabolic-disease focused translational research, implementing hPSC-derived disease models to deepen our understanding and potentially impact translational strategies.

  Your profile

• A PhD in life sciences or a similar relevant field 	
• Experience with hPSCs and tissue culture 	
• A background in metabolism or metabolic disease 	
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively

About the role

Are you an experienced Project Manager with a solid understanding of IT integrations and a talent for creating structure, progress and strong working relationships?

Scan Global Logistics is looking for a hands-on Technical Project Manager to support a major global transformation programme involving the implementation of new systems, global processes and data migration.

The programme implements a new Transportation Management System (TMFF), Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, and a Vendor Invoice Management solution (Basware and AP Essentials.

As Technical Project Manager, you will play a key role in driving and coordinating integration projects across teams, integration specialists and business stakeholders.

Your primary responsibility will be to create structure, draft plans, ensure progress and make sure that tasks, responsibilities, dependencies and deadlines are clearly defined and followed up.

You will act as the link between diverse teams and the business, helping translate technical challenges into clear business requirements – and vice versa.

This is not a developer role. However, you should have a good technical understanding of integrations, data flows and system dependencies, enabling you to engage confidently in technical discussions and challenge proposed solutions when needed.

You should also enjoy getting involved in the practical aspects of project management, including communication, documentation, process descriptions and mapping integration flows. It is a must that you know when to support and when to drive tasks, content, colleagues to ensure progress.

Key responsibilities

• Drive and coordinate integration projects across implementation and integration teams and vendor teams, i.e., integration to e-invoicing governmental portals

• Act as the link between technical teams, system owners, implementation teams and business stakeholders.

• Create structure, clear priorities, realistic timelines and well-defined project plans.

• Ensure proper task management and follow-up in Jira.

• Make sure tasks are clearly described, assigned to the right people and followed through to completion. You support the integration team with describing their tasks, flow descriptions, etc.

• Coordinate resources, dependencies and delivery schedules across teams.

• Support the documentation of integration flows, system dependencies and processes.

• Translate technical issues into business requirements and ensure alignment between business and IT.

• Follow up on progress, identify bottlenecks and help resolve issues before they impact delivery.

• Coordinate testing, deployment and operational handover where relevant.

Your background

We are looking for someone with solid experience in technical project management and, in particular, system integration projects.

You do not need to be a technical specialist or developer, but you must understand how systems communicate and how integrations work.

Ideally, you have:

• Experience managing IT integration projects.

• A good understanding of APIs, CSV, data flows and integration patterns.

• An understanding of system dependencies and how different applications interact.

• Experience coordinating technical teams, developers or integration specialists.

• Experience with project planning, resource coordination, and delivery follow-up.

• Experience using Jira or similar project management tools.

• The ability to create clear documentation, process descriptions and integration flow diagrams.

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, ERP or TMS solutions is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Experience from logistics and transportation is also an advantage, but we are equally interested in candidates from finance, operations or other industries who have moved into IT and integration projects.

Who are you?

Your personality will be just as important as your technical and project management experience.

You are someone who can create momentum and gain the respect of others without relying on formal management authority.

You are structured, detail-oriented and persistent when it comes to following up and ensuring that things get done.

At the same time, you are approachable and understand the importance of building good relationships.

You are comfortable working with different personalities, handling disagreements and challenging existing ways of working in a constructive manner.

You know when to push and when to listen. You can stand your ground without being overly dominant, and you understand that successful project delivery depends on bringing people along.

You are pragmatic, have a good sense of humour and can navigate different situations with confidence and good judgement.

The team

You will report to the Programme Lead and work closely with integration specialists, system owners, workstream leads, implementation project managers and solution architects to mention just a few.

What we offer

• An important role in a major global transformation programme.

• An international working environment with colleagues across different countries.

• A role combining technical insight, project management and relationship building.

• The opportunity to make a visible difference to project delivery and collaboration.

Location: Hvidovre is preferred, but Viby is also an option for the right candidate.

**Travel:**Approximately once a month between locations.

Contact

The recruitment process is handled by EPICO Group. If you have any questions about the position, please contact: Mia Mûller, Senior Delivery Manager, Email: mbm@epico.dk, Prone: +45 2866 3943.

Why Scan Global Logistics?

At Scan Global Logistics, you will join a global growth company with an entrepreneurial spirit and a fast-paced environment. You will play a central role in a strategic transformation with high visibility and the opportunity to make a real impact.

Scan Global Logistics is a leading Danish logistics and transportation company headquartered in Hvidovre, Denmark. We provide global solutions within sea, air and road freight as well as supply chain management, helping businesses move their goods safely and efficiently around the world.

Are you interested in gaining hands-on experience within Global Procurement at one of the world's leading jewellery brands? Do you enjoy working with data, analysis, and stakeholder collaboration in a dynamic international environment?

Pandora is looking for a Student Assistant to join our Global Procurement team. In this role, you will support sourcing activities, procurement projects, and business analysis across different spend categories while working closely with category managers and stakeholders across the organisation.

We hope you can demonstrate:

• Excellent communication skills in English

• Strong Excel skills and an analytical mindset

• A genuine interest in Procurement and related disciplines

• Great interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships across different functions

• A flair for creating professional and impactful presentations in PowerPoint

Personal Competencies

We are looking for someone who is:

• Proactive, curious, and eager to learn

• A humble and enthusiastic team player

• Comfortable working independently and taking ownership

• Structured and detail-oriented in their approach

• Not afraid to take initiative and responsibility

You Will Get

A position as Student Assistant in Global Procurement offers an opportunity for both personal and professional development in a global organisation.

• Valuable work experience from a globally recognised brand within Procurement across different spend categories

• Exposure to a fast-moving and dynamic environment where our people and values are at the centre of what we do

• A chance to challenge yourself and apply what you have learned in a global business environment

Additional Information

This role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Did We Get Your Attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

Icing on the Cake

Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery using 100% recycled silver and gold. We work closely with global project teams to ensure efficient site setups that keep projects running smoothly and safely.

Site Solutions is a great team of nine employees, and the Senior Project Manager will work closely with all team members while contributing both strategically and operationally to the development and delivery of our services.

• Coordinate clients, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and authorities.

• Ensure projects comply with applicable regulations, HSE requirements, and quality standards.

Business Development

• Support business growth through networking, client engagement, and market development.

• Contribute to proposals, commercial discussions, and new project opportunities.

• Help strengthen New Power Partners' position within the Danish construction sector.

Team Development

• Mentor and support junior project managers and consultants.

• Share knowledge and best practices across projects.

• Support recruitment and onboarding as the team grows.

• Contribute to building a collaborative and high-performing project organization.

Qualifications & Experience

• Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Building Technology, or a related discipline.

• 8+ years of project management experience within the Danish building and construction industry.

• Proven track record delivering commercial, industrial, residential, infrastructure, or mixed-use projects.

• Strong understanding of Danish construction processes and regulations.

• Experience with contract management, procurement, and stakeholder management.

• Familiarity with AB18, ABT18, and ABR18 is an advantage.

• Fluent in Danish and English.

Key Competencies

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills.

• Commercially minded with sound contractual understanding.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.

• Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented.

• Ability to balance hands-on project execution with business development.

• Leadership potential with an interest in developing people and teams.

Success in the Role

Success will be measured by:

• Safe and successful project delivery.

• High client satisfaction and repeat business.

• Strong financial and commercial project performance.

• Development of new business opportunities.

• Contribution to the growth of the project management team and the wider business.

Why join New Power Partners?

You will work in an international project environment, collaborate with experienced colleagues and customers, and play a role in shaping the future of Site Solutions.

This role is ideal for an experienced Senior Project Manager who enjoys delivering complex projects, building strong client relationships, and contributing to the growth of both the business and future project teams**.

**Job Description

**Interest rate markets move constantly, and the people who understand them shape how risk is managed for clients across the region. Joining our Derivatives Trading team you will be working directly with experienced traders and building practical expertise in interest-rate options from day one.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will be part of a close-knit trading team where analysis, precision, and curiosity matter every day. Working within Derivatives Trading, you will support the pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions, monitor market developments, and collaborate with colleagues across sales, quant, risk, and operations.

More specifically, you will:

• Support pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions under experienced traders

• Monitor interest rate markets, volatility, and economic developments with the team

• Analyse portfolio exposures and help manage risk within agreed limits

• Build and improve tools for pricing and risk monitoring using Python or similar languages

• Collaborate with sales, quant, risk, and operations colleagues to support accurate trade processing

**About You

**You are a recent graduate or have up to two years of relevant experience in trading, quantitative analysis, asset management or a related field. Previous trading experience is not required. We are interested in your analytical ability, curiosity and willingness to learn.

• Degree in economics with a technical focus, alternatively in mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related quantitative field

• Strong numerical and analytical skills with a structured approach to problem solving

• Genuine interest in fixed income markets and a desire to build a career in trading

• Programming ability in Python or a comparable language, applied to practical problems

• Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language

• Sound judgement, attention to detail, and willingness to ask questions and raise concerns

Familiarity with derivatives, probability, statistics, or numerical methods is an advantage, though no prior trading experience is required. Academic projects, relevant coursework, or internships are all useful ways to demonstrate your analytical interest.

**What We Offer You

**This role offers structured learning through direct collaboration with experienced traders, with responsibility growing as your knowledge deepens. This is a full-time, in-office role with daily access to colleagues who are invested in your progress and development.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, apply by submitting your CV, cover letter and grade transcripts. If you have any questions before applying you can reach out to hiring manager Frederik Dimo-Ungermann at fdi@danskebank.dk.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!
